To: GCI-Office365 <GCI-Office365@gannett.com>; ByteBack (Gannett Cybersecurity Team) <byteback@gannett.com>; Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Low-severity alert: Creation of forwarding/redirect rule to "anthonyfenech@hotmail.com"
Hello Anthony,
We just received this notice that you have a forward rule in Office 365 that is sending email outside of Gannett.
Could you please provide details on this forward as it’s against company policy to forward emails to outside sources?
The activity of forwarding email to external email accounts is strictly prohibited per Gannett's Acceptable Use policy which states the following –
"Transmission of Gannett business data to external sources without proper authorization is strictly prohibited"
Can you please remove this forward rule you have created?
